 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Quickstart (CLI)\n",
    "\n",
    "This document is for teach the basic usage of CoolBox's Command Line Interface.\n",
    "\n",
    "Interactive online version: [binder](https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/GangCaoLab/CoolBox/HEAD?filepath=docs%2Fsource%2Fquick_start_CLI.ipynb)\n",
    "\n",
    "CoolBox CLI is a chainable command tool which can compose\n",
    "complex frame as easily with very intuition syntax.\n",
    "\n",
    "![fig_CLI](../images/fig_CLI.png)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Check the basic information\n",
    "\n",
    "Firstly, check the coolbox version:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:04.095461Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2025-11-10T03:55:04.095304Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2025-11-10T03:55:10.076493Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2025-11-10T03:55:10.076035Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "0.4.0\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "%%bash\n",
    "\n",
    "coolbox version"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "CoolBox CLI is composed by many chainable sub-commands,\n",
    "we can print the help information to list them:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:10.079559Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2025-11-10T03:55:10.079225Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2025-11-10T03:55:16.180007Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2025-11-10T03:55:16.179254Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mNAME\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    coolbox - CoolBox Command Line Interface\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mSYNOPSIS\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    coolbox - \u001b[4mGROUP\u001b[0m | \u001b[4mCOMMAND\u001b[0m | \u001b[4mVALUE\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mDESCRIPTION\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    You can use this cli to create coolbox browser instance,\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    visualize your data directly in shell.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    example:\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    1. Draw tracks within a genome range, save figure to a pdf file:\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "        $ coolbox add XAxis - add BigWig test.bw - goto \"chr1:5000000-6000000\" - plot test.pdf\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    2. Generate a notebook and run jupyter to open browser:\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "        $ coolbox add XAxis - add BigWig test.bw - goto \"chr1:5000000-6000000\" - run_jupyter\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    3. Run a independent web application.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "        $ coolbox add XAxis - add BigWig test.bw - goto \"chr1:5000000-6000000\" - run_webapp\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mGROUPS\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    \u001b[1m\u001b[4mGROUP\u001b[0m\u001b[0m is one of the following:\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     current_range\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     frames\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mCOMMANDS\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    \u001b[1m\u001b[4mCOMMAND\u001b[0m\u001b[0m is one of the following:\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     add\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Add a Element(Track, Coverage, Feature), for example: coolbox add XAxis\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     end_with\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       End the with block\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     gen_notebook\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Generate The notebook contain codes for run coolbox browser.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     goto\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Goto a genome range.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     joint_view\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Start a new frame positioned at the specified frame_pos in the final joint view. The center frame should be a single Cool, HicMat, DotHic track.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     load_module\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Import custom tracks from a module/package for example:\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     plot\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Draw a figure within a genome range and save to file\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     print_source\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Print the browser composing code.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     run_jupyter\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Create a notebook according to command line, then start a jupyter process.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     run_webapp\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Run a independent coolbox browser web app. (Create notebook and run voila)\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     set_genome\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Set reference genome for browser object.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     show_doc\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Print the document of specified Element type. For example: coolbox show_doc Cool\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     source\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     start_with\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       Start a 'with' block, apply the element to all elements within the block.\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     version\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "       print coolbox version\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mVALUES\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    \u001b[1m\u001b[4mVALUE\u001b[0m\u001b[0m is one of the following:\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     frame_pos\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "     genome\n"
     ]
    }
   ],

    "coolbox"
   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Compose Frame\n",
    "\n",
    "CoolBox CLI is designed for compose Frame object by a command chain.\n",
    "The key command of the chain is the `add` sub-command,\n",
    "It just like the `+` operator in CoolBox API."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:16.904918Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2025-11-10T03:55:16.904498Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2025-11-10T03:55:23.340723Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2025-11-10T03:55:23.338668Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mNAME\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    coolbox add - Add a Element(Track, Coverage, Feature), for example: coolbox add XAxis\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mSYNOPSIS\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    coolbox add \u001b[4mELEM_STR\u001b[0m <flags> [\u001b[4mARGS\u001b[0m]...\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\u001b[1mDESCRIPTION\u001b[0m\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    Add a Element(Track, Coverage, Feature), for example: coolbox add XAxis\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stderr",

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Here, give a example of draw a figure using CoolBox CLI:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:23.344311Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2025-11-10T03:55:23.343883Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2025-11-10T03:55:28.502387Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2025-11-10T03:55:28.501799Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%%bash\n",
    "\n",
    "DIR=../../tests/test_data\n",
    "\n",
    "coolbox add XAxis - \\\n",
    "add Cool $DIR/cool_chr9_4000000_6000000.mcool - \\\n",
    "add Title \"cool\" - \\\n",
    "add BAMCov $DIR/bam_chr9_4000000_6000000.bam - \\\n",
    "add Title \"bam\" - \\\n",
    "add BigWig $DIR/bigwig_chr9_4000000_6000000.bw - \\\n",
    "add Title \"bigwig\" - \\\n",
    "goto \"chr9:4000000-6000000\" - \\\n",
    "plot /tmp/test_coolbox.jpg"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We have draw a figure and save it to `/tmp/test_coolbox.jpg`, let's take a look:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:28.504684Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2025-11-10T03:55:28.504504Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2025-11-10T03:55:28.513434Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2025-11-10T03:55:28.512935Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/jpeg": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<IPython.core.display.Image object>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from IPython.display import Image\n",
    "Image(filename='/tmp/test_coolbox.jpg') "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "As we can see, we compose our data using the `add` command,\n",
    "then plot the figure.\n",
    "\n",
    "The first argument of `add` is the coolbox element type name.\n",
    "The most frequently used element is the `Track`,\n",
    "all `Track` type can be found [here](https://gangcaolab.github.io/CoolBox/quick_start_API.html#Track-types)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### with block\n",
    "\n",
    "For modify features or add coverage to a group of tracks, you can use the `with` block, \n",
    "it's the equivalent of the [`with statement` in API](https://gangcaolab.github.io/CoolBox/quick_start_API.html#with-statement). \n",
    "\n",
    "For example modify track's color:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:28.516502Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2025-11-10T03:55:28.516309Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2025-11-10T03:55:32.442923Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2025-11-10T03:55:32.442324Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%%bash \n",
    "\n",
    "DIR=../../tests/test_data\n",
    "\n",
    "coolbox add XAxis - \\\n",
    "start_with Color \"#ffcc66\" - \\\n",
    "add BigWig $DIR/bigwig_chr9_4000000_6000000.bw - \\\n",
    "add BigWig $DIR/bigwig_chr9_4000000_6000000.bw - \\\n",
    "end_with - \\\n",
    "start_with Color \"#cc66ff\" - \\\n",
    "add BigWig $DIR/bigwig_chr9_4000000_6000000.bw - \\\n",
    "add BigWig $DIR/bigwig_chr9_4000000_6000000.bw - \\\n",
    "end_with - \\\n",
    "goto \"chr9:4000000-6000000\" - \\\n",
    "plot /tmp/test_coolbox.jpg"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:32.445600Z",

   "source": [
    "%%bash \n",
    "\n",

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Start a browser\n",
    "\n",
    "CoolBox `CLI` can automatically generate\n",
    "a notebook which contain the \n",
    "browser composition code equivalent to using CoolBox `API`.\n",
    "\n",
    "And this notebook will be run in Jupyter environment or Volia webapp.\n",
    "Then you can open your web browser to use this GUI to explore your genomic data, for example:\n",
    "\n",
    "```Bash\n",
    "$ coolbox add XAxis - \\\n",
    "add Cool ./tests/test_data/cool_chr9_4000000_6000000.mcool - \\\n",
    "add BAM ./tests/test_data/bam_chr9_4000000_6000000.bam - \\\n",
    "add BigWig ./tests/test_data/bigwig_chr9_4000000_6000000.bw - \\\n",
    "goto \"chr9:4000000-6000000\" - \\\n",
    "run_jupyter\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "This will start a jupyter server and run a coolbox browser within the notebook.\n",
    "And you can also to run a independent web app using similar command:\n",
    "\n",
    "```Bash\n",
    "$ coolbox add XAxis - \\\n",
    "add Cool ./tests/test_data/cool_chr9_4000000_6000000.mcool - \\\n",
    "add BAM ./tests/test_data/bam_chr9_4000000_6000000.bam - \\\n",
    "add BigWig ./tests/test_data/bigwig_chr9_4000000_6000000.bw - \\\n",
    "goto \"chr9:4000000-6000000\" - \\\n",
    "run_webapp\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "More detail usage see the help info:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:36.720114Z",

    }

   "cell_type": "code",

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Load custom module\n",
    "\n",
    "We can load the custom defined module(`.py` file) with the `load_module` command.\n",
    "For example, there are a simple custom defined track in `custom_track.py`:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:43.130256Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2025-11-10T03:55:43.130080Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2025-11-10T03:55:43.150346Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2025-11-10T03:55:43.149685Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "from coolbox.core.track.base import Track\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "class CustomTrack(Track):\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    def __init__(self):\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "        super().__init__(properties_dict={})\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    def fetch_data(self, gr, **kwargs):\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "        return \"Test Custom\"\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "    def plot(self, ax, gr, **kwargs):\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "        x = gr.start + gr.length * 0.33\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "        ax.text(x, 0, self.fetch_data(gr), fontsize=50)\r\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "        ax.set_xlim(gr.start, gr.end)\r\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "%%bash\n",
    "\n",
    "DIR=../../tests/\n",
    "\n",
    "cat $DIR/custom_track.py"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We can load it from the file with `load_module` then use it to draw a plot:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2025-11-10T03:55:43.153669Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2025-11-10T03:55:43.152920Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2025-11-10T03:55:46.371094Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2025-11-10T03:55:46.370652Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%%bash\n",
    "\n",
    "DIR=../../tests/\n",
    "\n",
    "coolbox - load_module $DIR/custom_track.py - \\\n",
    "    add XAxis - \\\n",
    "    add CustomTrack - \\\n",
    "    goto \"chr1:10000-20000\" - \\\n",
    "    plot /tmp/test_coolbox_custom_cli.png"
   ]
  },
